step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture details an automated migration factory designed to move on-premises servers to AWS. It operates in two main phases: Preparation and Automated Migration. During preparation, the Migration Team populates target configuration metadata (such as IPs, subnets, and tags) into DynamoDB. On-premises servers run the Application Discovery Service agent to collect network/performance metrics, and the CloudEndure agent to continuously replicate block-level data into an EC2 Hot Replica in AWS. When the migration is triggered, the Migration Team sends a Slack command that calls an API on the EC2 Migration Factory orchestrator. The EC2 orchestrator queries the Application Discovery Service and DynamoDB to fetch server configurations, commands CloudEndure to halt replication, bakes an AMI from the Hot Replica, and launches the final target EC2 instance in the target account with all custom tags and configurations applied.

graph.name: Automated AWS Migration Factory Architecture
graph.notes: Automates the migration of on-premises servers to AWS in approximately 10 minutes per server by utilizing CloudEndure and AWS Application Discovery Service coordinated by an EC2-hosted Migration Factory.

nodes.name: Migration Team
nodes.notes: Initiates the automated migration process and sets up configurations.

nodes.name: Slack
nodes.notes: Receives chat commands to trigger the migration workflow via API call.

nodes.name: On-Premises Server
nodes.notes: The source servers running discovery and replication agents.

nodes.name: Application Discovery Service
nodes.notes: Gathers TCP mapping, system metadata, and utilization metrics.

nodes.name: DynamoDB
nodes.notes: Stores migration metadata, target accounts, tags, IPs, and RTO/RPO requirements.

nodes.name: EC2 (Migration Factory)
nodes.notes: The orchestration server running scripts to automate the migration process.

nodes.name: CloudEndure
nodes.notes: Manages block-level volume replication to the replication instance.

nodes.name: EC2 Hot Replica
nodes.notes: The replication instance receiving live updates from the on-premises server.

nodes.name: Target EC2 Instance
nodes.notes: The final launched server in the target AWS account.

edges.notes: Migration team populates target configurations, tags, subnets, and IPs into DynamoDB.
Application Discovery Service agent collects TCP dependencies and system resource usage.
On-prem data is replicated continuously block-by-block using CloudEndure agents.
Migration team triggers the migration using a Slack command.
Slack makes an API call to initiate execution on the EC2 Migration Factory orchestrator.
EC2 Migration Factory queries Application Discovery Service for TCP connections and performance metrics.
EC2 Migration Factory retrieves target metadata, instance sizes, and custom tags from DynamoDB.
EC2 Migration Factory requests CloudEndure to halt active block-level replication.
CloudEndure agent pauses the continuous replication to prepare for AMI creation.
EC2 Migration Factory creates (bakes) an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) from the EC2 Hot Replica volumes.
EC2 Migration Factory shares the baked AMI with the target account and launches the final target EC2 instance with custom tagging and network configurations.
